rules.source_quote: Initial Staging, Restaging, Pre-surgical evaluation, Recurrence, Surveillance ○ NOT Indicated

criteria.description: Patient has confirmed diagnosis of primary chondrosarcoma

required_documentation: Pathology or oncology notes documenting conventional chondrosarcoma
exclusion_conditions: PET/CT is non-covered for staging, restaging, pre-surgical planning, recurrence, or surveillance of standard chondrosarcoma
rules.review_notes: Explicit non-coverage policy exclusion: chondrosarcoma is evaluated with conventional CT/MRI rather than PET.

rules.source_quote: Indicated to clarify inconclusive conventional imaging

criteria.description: Biopsy-proven chordoma undergoing staging or restaging
Conventional CT or MRI studies of the primary site, chest, or abdomen/pelvis are inconclusive or equivocal

required_documentation: Conventional CT/MRI reports documenting indeterminate findings requiring metabolic PET clarification
rules.review_notes: Diagnostic clarification pathway for chordoma when conventional imaging is inconclusive.

rules.source_section: INDICATIONS / Lymphoma / Primary CNS Lymphoma and Systemic Lymphoma

criteria.description: Biopsy-proven Hodgkin Lymphoma or FDG-avid Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma undergoing initial staging, mid-treatment response evaluation, or end-of-treatment remission assessment

required_documentation: Pathology report confirming lymphoma subtype and oncology treatment plan
rules.review_notes: Whole-body PET/CT is reference standard for staging and Lugano response assessment in lymphoma.

rules.source_section: INDICATIONS / Lung Cancer / Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

criteria.description: Proven or suspected Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) with solid nodule >= 8 mm or indeterminate solitary pulmonary nodule being evaluated for initial staging or distant metastasis

required_documentation: Diagnostic Chest CT report documenting nodule/mass characteristics and oncology consult notes
rules.review_notes: Whole-body PET/CT indicated for initial staging and nodal assessment of NSCLC.

rules.clinical_service_or_procedure: PET Scan (Any Site, NOS / Breast Cancer Initial Diagnosis / Non-covered Melanoma)

criteria.description: PET imaging requested using non-specific tumor imaging code (any site, not otherwise specified)
PET scan requested for initial diagnosis of breast cancer or axillary staging

required_documentation: Oncology order and clinical notes identifying tumor type, staging intent, and procedure code
exclusion_conditions: PET imaging NOS (G0219, G0235, G0252) and initial breast cancer staging are categorically non-covered
rules.review_notes: Explicit non-coverage exclusion: PET any site NOS and initial staging of axillary lymph nodes in breast cancer.
